content:
- Pushed commit 8a22f78 to origin/master successfully.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it exited 0, updated .ralph/current_tasks.md and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md, and again printed the known rm warning for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next if a new context window starts: read progress, inspect current Ralph-generated task files, and continue from the switched task state.

- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill, checked found_smells first, and confirmed there was no queued smell file beyond .gitkeep.
- Explored several candidate smell-9 boundaries and chose the smallest clean win in src/cli: response JSON decode errors were flattened into CliError::Decode(String).
- Patched src/cli/error.rs so CliError::Decode now stores serde_json::Error as a typed source, updated src/cli/client.rs to map decode failures directly, and added a unit test that asserts source preservation.
- Next: run formatting if needed, then make lint and make test, inspect failures, and either fix or record any newly spotted bugs immediately.

- Verified the patch diff and queued full verification next.
- Running cargo fmt --all before the required make lint and make test so clippy output is not polluted by formatting drift.
- If lint or test exposes a real issue, fix it or create an add-bug task immediately per repo instructions.

- make lint failed once on clippy::unwrap_used in the new decode-error unit test.
- Replaced unwrap_err with an explicit match/panic pattern in src/cli/error.rs and reformatted.
- Next: rerun make lint, then make test once lint is green.

- make lint failed a second time because clippy::panic also applies in tests here.
- Converted decode_errors_keep_source_and_exit_code to return Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> and use io::Error::other on the unexpected success path instead of panic.
- Next: rerun make lint again, then proceed to make test if green.

- make lint then failed on a test import issue: Box<dyn Error> needed the trait name, not only the method import alias.
- Fixed the test import in src/cli/error.rs and reformatted.
- Next: rerun make lint again; if green, move straight to make test.

- make lint passed after the test cleanup iterations.
- make test passed via cargo nextest and the junit-log conversion step also completed successfully.
- Next: inspect final git status/diff, commit including .ralph files, push to origin, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Removed rustfmt-only drift from tests/ha/support/docker/cli.rs so this run stays scoped to the CLI decode boundary change.
- Worktree is now limited to src/cli changes plus the expected .ralph progress/task files.
- Next: git add, commit, push, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
